title: Near being lagged only Paddy Leonard knew the bobby
html_source: “Lagged” is a term meaning apprehended or arrested; this fate was avoided on account of Paddy knowing “the bobby”, or the officer in question. Interestingly, the term bobby for a police officer derives from the diminutive form of the name of Robert Peel, who served as Prime Minister twice in the first half of the 19th century and who founded the London Metropolitan Police.
